meta.title: Northstar Operations
meta.purpose: Introduce a decision workspace for field operations
meta.author: VibePPT

slides.title:
See the signal.
Move with confidence.
slides.body: Northstar turns scattered operational evidence into one calm decision surface.
slides.notes: Open with the operator problem, not the feature list. Ask where decisions currently slow down.

slides.title: More dashboards did not create more clarity.
slides.body: Teams still assemble the same incident by hand across messages, spreadsheets and disconnected systems.

items.title: Signal
items.body: Know what changed.

items.title: Context
items.body: Understand why it matters.

items.title: Action
items.body: Assign the next move.

items.title: Investigate
items.body: Move from an alert to its supporting evidence.

items.title: Coordinate
items.body: Give the issue an owner, state and next action.

items.title: Learn
items.body: Turn repeated incidents into operating changes.

items.title: Detect

items.title: Verify

slides.title: Measure the handoff, not the hype.
slides.body: The first pilot follows three operational outcomes.

items.label: Time to verify

items.label: Ownership

items.label: Closed loop
items.body: Resolved with outcome and supporting evidence.

slides.title: Four weeks. Three measures. One decision.
A high-priority exception arrives at 09:17.
slides.body: The operator verifies the evidence, assigns the field lead and records the outcome before the shift changes.

slides.title: Choose one workflow worth making visible.
slides.body: Bring one real operating scenario, its evidence sources and the decision that currently takes too long.
slides.notes: End with a question: which operational handoff costs the team the most time today?
